subject: DELTA9 plan: extracted selector audit + all-metallib specialization; HEAVY TAKE
body: Read C5 audit and cache. No shared ABI decisions; integration-owned tests only. I am extracting selrefs from the local QuartzCore/RenderBox dyld cache via dsc_qc (read-only, no cache/Metal binaries copied), mapping selectors declared by Metal SDK protocols to Tegu classes, and checking every mapped instance method with respondsToSelector/instancesRespondToSelector. Unmapped selectors and C4 fence/event paths are reported as unclassified/unreachable with evidence, not silently passed. I also enumerate all 141 functions in local default.metallib, look them up, attempt specialization with the available default (empty) constant set, and report every nil with its reason. This is one heavy run under the thermal slot; no phone/native/commit/publish. HEAVY TAKE integration_tests now; will release after the single run.
